questions.t: İstanbul hangi yıl fethedildi?
questions.e: In which year was Constantinople conquered?
questions.xe: Mehmed II took the city on 29 May 1453.

questions.t: Fatih Sultan Mehmed İstanbul'u fethettiğinde kaç yaşındaydı?
questions.e: How old was Mehmed the Conqueror when he took Constantinople?
questions.xe: Born in 1432, he was 21 at the conquest.

questions.t: Osmanlı Devleti'nin kurucusu kimdir?
questions.e: Who founded the Ottoman state?
questions.x: Devlet adını kurucusu Osman Gazi'den alır.
questions.xe: The state takes its name from its founder, Osman.

questions.t: Kanuni Sultan Süleyman kaç yıl tahtta kaldı?
questions.e: How many years did Suleiman the Magnificent reign?
questions.xe: From 1520 to 1566, 46 years: the longest reign.

questions.t: Mohaç Meydan Muharebesi hangi yıl yapıldı?
questions.e: In which year was the Battle of Mohács fought?
questions.x: Macaristan kralı II. Layoş 1526'da Mohaç'ta yenildi.
questions.xe: King Louis II of Hungary was defeated at Mohács in 1526.

questions.t: Preveze Deniz Savaşı'nda Osmanlı donanmasını kim komuta etti?
questions.e: Who commanded the Ottoman fleet at the Battle of Preveza?
questions.xe: In 1538 Barbarossa defeated the Holy League fleet at Preveza.

questions.t: Mimar Sinan hangi caminin “ustalık eserim” olduğunu söyledi?
questions.e: Which mosque did Mimar Sinan call his “masterpiece”?
questions.x: Edirne'deki Selimiye'yi Sinan ustalık eseri saydı.
questions.xe: Sinan regarded the Selimiye in Edirne as his masterwork.

questions.t: Yavuz Sultan Selim 1517'de Kahire önlerinde Memlükleri hangi savaşta yendi?
questions.e: In which battle near Cairo did Selim I defeat the Mamluks in 1517?
questions.xe: Ridaniye brought Egypt under Ottoman rule.

questions.t: Halifelik Osmanlılara hangi padişah döneminde geçti?
questions.e: Under which sultan did the caliphate pass to the Ottomans?
questions.xe: After the Egyptian campaign, in 1517.

questions.t: 1402 Ankara Savaşı'nda Yıldırım Bayezid kime yenildi?
questions.e: To whom did Bayezid I lose at the Battle of Ankara in 1402?
questions.xe: Defeated by Timur, Bayezid was taken prisoner.

questions.t: Lale Devri hangi padişah döneminde yaşandı?
questions.e: Under which sultan did the Tulip Era take place?
questions.xe: 1718 to 1730, in the reign of Ahmed III.

questions.t: Lale Devri'nin sadrazamı kimdi?
questions.e: Who was the grand vizier of the Tulip Era?
questions.xe: Damat Ibrahim Pasha was grand vizier from 1718 to 1730.

questions.t: Lale Devri hangi isyanla sona erdi?
questions.e: Which revolt ended the Tulip Era?
questions.xe: The Patrona Halil Revolt of 1730 closed the era.

questions.t: Osmanlı'da Türkçe kitap basan ilk matbaayı kim kurdu?
questions.e: Who founded the first press printing books in Ottoman Turkish?
questions.xe: Müteferrika's press opened in 1727.

questions.t: Topkapı Sarayı'nı hangi padişah yaptırdı?
questions.e: Which sultan had Topkapı Palace built?
questions.xe: Mehmed II built it in the 1460s after the conquest.

questions.t: Padişah katılmadığında Divan-ı Hümayun'a kim başkanlık ederdi?
questions.e: Who chaired the Imperial Council when the sultan was absent?
questions.xe: From Mehmed II onwards the grand vizier presided.

questions.t: Divan'da devletin mali işlerinden kim sorumluydu?
questions.e: Who handled state finances in the Imperial Council?
questions.x: Defterdar, hazinenin gelir ve giderine bakardı.
questions.xe: The defterdar oversaw treasury income and spending.

questions.t: Padişahın tuğrasını belgelere çeken Divan üyesi kimdi?
questions.e: Which council member drew the sultan's tughra on documents?
questions.xe: The nişancı inscribed the tughra on decrees.

questions.t: Yeniçeri Ocağı'nı hangi padişah kaldırdı?
questions.e: Which sultan abolished the Janissary Corps?
questions.xe: In 1826, the 'Auspicious Incident'.

questions.t: Bağdat'ı 1638'de geri alan padişah kimdir?
questions.e: Which sultan retook Baghdad in 1638?
questions.x: IV. Murad Bağdat Seferi'ni bizzat yönetti.
questions.xe: Murad IV led the Baghdad campaign in person.

questions.t: Viyana'yı ilk kez (1529) hangi padişah kuşattı?
questions.e: Which sultan first besieged Vienna, in 1529?
questions.xe: Suleiman lifted the siege as winter set in.

questions.t: 1683 İkinci Viyana Kuşatması'nda Osmanlı ordusunu hangi sadrazam yönetti?
questions.e: Which grand vizier led the army at the second siege of Vienna in 1683?
questions.x: Yenilgiden sonra Kara Mustafa idam edildi.
questions.xe: Kara Mustafa was executed after the defeat.

questions.t: Karlofça Antlaşması hangi yıl imzalandı?
questions.e: In which year was the Treaty of Karlowitz signed?
questions.xe: The first major Ottoman loss of territory.

questions.t: Bursa hangi padişah döneminde fethedildi?
questions.e: Under which ruler was Bursa conquered?
questions.xe: Taken in 1326, Bursa became the capital.

questions.t: Edirne'yi alıp başkent yapan padişah kimdir?
questions.e: Which sultan took Edirne and made it the capital?
questions.xe: Edirne stayed the capital until Constantinople fell.

questions.t: 1389 Kosova Savaşı'nda şehit düşen padişah kimdir?
questions.e: Which sultan was killed at the Battle of Kosovo in 1389?
questions.x: Savaş kazanıldı ama I. Murad savaş alanında öldürüldü.
questions.xe: The battle was won, but Murad I was killed on the field.

questions.t: Kanuni Sultan Süleyman Avrupa'da hangi lakapla anılır?
questions.e: By what epithet is Suleiman known in Europe?
questions.xe: His own people called him the Lawgiver; Europe, the Magnificent.

questions.t: Evliya Çelebi'nin ünlü eserinin adı nedir?
questions.e: What is the name of Evliya Çelebi's famous work?
questions.xe: A travel account in ten volumes.

questions.t: Katip Çelebi'nin dünya coğrafyası kitabının adı nedir?
questions.e: What is Katip Çelebi's book of world geography called?
questions.xe: Cihannüma was later printed by Müteferrika's press.

questions.t: Piri Reis'in denizcilik kitabının adı nedir?
questions.e: What is Piri Reis's book of navigation called?
questions.xe: It describes the Mediterranean coasts with charts.

questions.t: Piri Reis'in ünlü dünya haritası hangi yıl çizildi?
questions.e: In which year did Piri Reis draw his famous world map?
questions.x: Haritada Amerika kıyıları da yer alır.
questions.xe: The map includes the coasts of the Americas.

questions.t: Kanuni döneminin ünlü Şeyhülislamı kimdir?
questions.e: Who was the famous Şeyhülislam of Suleiman's reign?
questions.xe: Ebussuud held the office from 1545 to 1574.

questions.t: Hürrem Sultan hangi padişahın eşiydi?
questions.e: Hürrem Sultan was the wife of which sultan?
questions.xe: Suleiman formally married her.

questions.t: IV. Murad'ın annesi kimdir?
questions.e: Who was the mother of Murad IV?
questions.x: Kösem Sultan, IV. Murad ve İbrahim'in annesiydi.
questions.xe: Kösem was the mother of Murad IV and Ibrahim.

questions.t: Sokullu Mehmed Paşa kaç padişaha sadrazamlık yaptı?
questions.e: How many sultans did Sokollu Mehmed Pasha serve as grand vizier?
questions.x: Kanuni, II. Selim ve III. Murad.
questions.xe: Suleiman I, Selim II and Murad III.

questions.t: Sokullu Mehmed Paşa hangi iki nehri kanalla birleştirmek istedi?
questions.e: Which two rivers did Sokollu plan to join with a canal?
oe: the Nile and the Red Sea
questions.xe: Digging began in 1569 but was never finished.

questions.t: 1514 Çaldıran Savaşı Osmanlılar ile kim arasında yapıldı?
questions.e: Whom did the Ottomans fight at Chaldiran in 1514?
questions.xe: Selim I defeated Shah Ismail.

questions.t: 1516 Mercidabık Savaşı kime karşı kazanıldı?
questions.e: Against whom was the Battle of Marj Dabiq won in 1516?
questions.xe: This victory brought Syria under Ottoman rule.

questions.t: Osmanlı akçesi hangi madenden basılırdı?
questions.e: What metal was the Ottoman akçe struck from?
questions.x: Akçe gümüş bir sikkeydi; altın para “sultani” idi.
questions.xe: The akçe was silver; the gold coin was the sultani.

questions.t: Yeniçeriler hoşnutsuzluklarını nasıl gösterirdi?
questions.e: How did the Janissaries signal discontent?
questions.xe: Overturning the soup cauldron meant revolt.

questions.t: Devşirme ile toplanan çocuklar en çok hangi ocağa yetiştirilirdi?
questions.e: Boys taken through the devşirme were mostly trained for which corps?
questions.x: Kapıkulu askeri, başta yeniçeri olarak yetişirlerdi.
questions.xe: They became household troops, above all Janissaries.

questions.t: Tımar sahibi sipahi, toprağın gelirine karşılık ne yapardı?
questions.e: In return for his land revenue, what did a timar-holder provide?
questions.x: Gelire göre cebelü denilen atlı askerler getirirdi.
questions.xe: He brought armed horsemen in proportion to his income.

questions.t: Süleymaniye Camii'nin mimarı kimdir?
questions.e: Who was the architect of the Süleymaniye Mosque?
questions.xe: It was completed in 1557.

questions.t: Sultanahmet Camii'ni hangi padişah yaptırdı?
questions.e: Which sultan built the Sultan Ahmed (Blue) Mosque?
questions.xe: Built between 1609 and 1617.

questions.t: İstanbul kuşatmasındaki dev topları döken usta kimdi?
questions.e: Who cast the giant cannons for the siege of Constantinople?
questions.xe: Orban's guns battered the walls.

questions.t: Fatih Sultan Mehmed gemileri karadan yürüterek nereye indirdi?
questions.e: Where did Mehmed II lower his ships after hauling them overland?
oe: the Asian shore of the Bosphorus
questions.x: Zincirle kapalı Haliç'e gemiler karadan indirildi.
questions.xe: Ships were hauled overland into the chained-off Golden Horn.

questions.t: İlk resmî Osmanlı gazetesi hangisidir?
questions.e: Which was the first official Ottoman newspaper?
questions.xe: First issued in 1831 under Mahmud II.

questions.t: Tanzimat Fermanı hangi yıl ilan edildi?
questions.e: In which year was the Tanzimat Edict proclaimed?
questions.xe: It was read out at Gülhane.

questions.t: Osmanlı'nın ilk anayasası Kanun-i Esasi hangi yıl ilan edildi?
questions.e: In which year was the first Ottoman constitution, the Kanun-i Esasi, proclaimed?
questions.xe: At the start of Abdülhamid II's reign.

questions.t: Osmanlı'nın son padişahı kimdir?
questions.e: Who was the last Ottoman sultan?
questions.x: Abdülmecid Efendi padişah değil, son halifeydi.
questions.xe: Abdülmecid Efendi was the last caliph, not a sultan.

questions.t: Saltanat hangi tarihte kaldırıldı?
questions.e: On what date was the sultanate abolished?
questions.xe: The caliphate followed on 3 March 1924.

questions.t: Lale Devri'nin ünlü şairi kimdir?
questions.e: Who was the famous poet of the Tulip Era?
questions.x: Nedim, Sadabad'ı ve İstanbul eğlencelerini yazdı.
questions.xe: Nedim wrote of Sadabad and Istanbul's pleasures.

questions.t: Barbaros Hayreddin Paşa'nın asıl adı nedir?
questions.e: What was Hayreddin Barbarossa's original name?
questions.xe: Oruç was his elder brother.

questions.t: Kanuni Sultan Süleyman hangi kuşatma sırasında vefat etti?
questions.e: During which siege did Suleiman die?
questions.xe: In 1566, just before the fortress fell.

questions.t: Topkapı Sarayı'nda Divan'ın toplandığı bölümün adı nedir?
questions.e: What is the hall in Topkapı where the council met?
questions.xe: Kubbealtı became a name for the council itself.
